methods.description: Choose the time0 or first-period starting point and evaluate a later value.
Use the arithmetic-series formula for total accumulated amounts, distinguishing a single period.
Solve a linear threshold inequality, choose the first admissible integer period and check the boundary.
Use the nth-term equation to find an exact row/period index and a requested neighbouring term.
Form a quadratic from a known accumulated total, solve and reject nonphysical period counts.
Calculate two accumulated arithmetic totals over the same interval and compare their difference.
